items.q: What is HyperGain?
items.a: HyperGain is an automated perpetuals bot on Hyperliquid. You deposit USDC on your Hyperliquid account, approve the HyperGain trading agent once, and our server scans all HL markets 24/7 to open and close trades for you.

items.q: Is HyperGain safe to use?
items.a: HyperGain is non-custodial on Hyperliquid: your USDC stays on your HL account in your name. The trading agent can place trades but cannot withdraw without your wallet. Auto-trading runs only when you press Start bot.

items.q: Is HyperGain non-custodial?
items.a: Yes. Funds sit on your Hyperliquid account, not in a HyperGain vault. We never hold your private keys. Withdrawals always require your wallet signature on Hyperliquid.

items.q: Is HyperGain fully decentralized?
items.a: Trading executes on Hyperliquid infrastructure via an agent you approve. Signal analysis and automation run on HyperGain servers (Railway). You can verify balances and positions on app.hyperliquid.xyz at any time.

items.q: Is this financial advice?
items.a: No. HyperGain provides software for automated Hyperliquid perpetual trading — not investment, tax, or legal advice. Crypto and leveraged trading carry significant risk. Do your own research and only use funds you can afford to lose.

items.q: Why Hyperliquid for automated trading?
items.a: Hyperliquid offers deep perp liquidity, fast execution, and USDC margin on its own L1. One deposit on HL powers trading across all listed markets — simpler than bridging through legacy L2 vaults.

items.q: How does the trading bot work?
items.a: While the bot is running, HyperGain server (Railway) checks your HL balance every ~10 seconds, scans all Hyperliquid perps with multi-timeframe signals, opens the strongest setup, monitors take profit / stop loss, closes the position, then repeats.

items.q: How long does the trading bot run?
items.a: 24/7 while Start bot is on and you have at least $20 USDC on Hyperliquid. There is no session timeout — the server keeps cycling until you press Stop bot.

items.q: Can the bot trade 24/7?
items.a: Yes. Crypto markets never close. Once started, the bot scans all HL perps around the clock and can open or close positions at any hour — you do not need to stay online.

items.q: Can I close trades manually?
items.a: Yes. Open positions on Hyperliquid can be closed in the terminal or on app.hyperliquid.xyz. Stop bot halts new entries; existing HL positions remain until TP/SL or manual close.

items.q: Which crypto assets does the bot trade?
items.a: Any active Hyperliquid perpetual with a valid market signal — the bot loads the full HL universe (200+ pairs) and picks the strongest setup each cycle, not a fixed ETH/BTC list.

items.q: What leverage does the bot use?
items.a: You set leverage, take profit, and stop loss in bot settings. The bot clamps to Hyperliquid per-asset maximum (e.g. BTC 40×, ETH 25×) on each trade.

items.q: Do I need to keep my computer on?
items.a: No. The bot runs on HyperGain servers (Railway). After Start bot and a funded Hyperliquid account, it trades 24/7 without your browser open.

items.q: How do I deposit so the bot can start?
items.a: In HyperGain Funds (or app.hyperliquid.xyz): deposit only native USDC on Arbitrum One — not BNB, BSC, ETH mainnet, or USDC on other chains. Min. $5 on HL; bot needs $20+. Then approve agent → Start bot.

items.q: How much USDC do I need to start?
items.a: At least $20 USDC on your Hyperliquid account for the bot (HL minimum deposit is $5). Only fund what you want the bot to use — it trades from your HL balance, not a separate vault.

items.q: What fees does the bot charge?
items.a: Hyperliquid trading fees apply on each perp trade. HyperGain may charge a builder fee on HL orders and subscription tiers for bot access. Check the app for current subscription and fee settings.

items.q: Can I withdraw my USDC anytime?
items.a: Yes — from Hyperliquid to your wallet via the Funds panel or app.hyperliquid.xyz. Close open positions first if margin is in use. The trading agent cannot withdraw for you.

items.q: Why Hyperliquid instead of a vault?
items.a: Your USDC stays on your Hyperliquid account in your name. The bot only trades via an agent you approve; it cannot move funds out. You see balance and positions directly on HL.

items.q: Do I need to sign wallet transactions?
items.a: Yes for deposits, withdrawals, and the one-time agent approval. Ongoing bot trades are signed by the approved agent — you do not sign each trade manually.

items.q: What are verified sports markets on HyperGain?
items.a: Browse live and upcoming sports events listed as Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets — odds update on-chain as the book moves.

items.q: Is HyperGain betting non-custodial?
items.a: Your USDC stays on your Hyperliquid account. Orders are wallet-signed; HyperGain never holds your private keys.

items.q: How fast is on-chain betting execution?
items.a: Place Yes/No bets directly on Hyperliquid outcome contracts. Open positions, cash out, and track P/L in the app.

items.q: How does transparent settlement work?
items.a: Markets resolve on verified outcomes. Positions and balances are visible on Hyperliquid — no opaque bookmaker ledger.
